name: CLUCK!
summary: In Westfall, a chicken may answer when you call and feed it. Follow its scratched message to the Saldean family, and a warm egg may be yours to hatch.

sections.title: A Strange Communion
sections.body: Across Azeroth, ordinary chickens wander farmsteads, though most travelers pass them by. Mimic a chicken's gestures and cluck, and one may stop pecking to regard you. In that brief moment, it scratches letters in the dirt, pointing you toward the farmer who can provide the food it wants.

sections.title: The Farmer's Feed
sections.body: The bird asks for Special Chicken Feed, which the Saldean family keeps for its flock in Westfall. Offer the grain and cheer the chicken on as it eats. In return, it lays a warm egg, ready to be nurtured into a feathered companion.

faq.q: How does a chicken offer a quest?
faq.answer: Mimic a chicken with repeated calls or flapping gestures. At last, it pauses to inspect you and scratches a message in the dirt about its hunger.

faq.q: What does the chicken spell out in the dirt?
faq.answer: The chicken scratches out S-A-L-D-E-A-N in the soil. The name points to Farmer Saldean and his wife at the Saldean Farm in central Westfall, where they sell the grain it wants.

faq.q: Where do you get the Special Chicken Feed?
faq.answer: Farmer Saldean keeps Special Chicken Feed at the Saldean Farm in Westfall.

faq.q: Can you do this with any chicken in the world?
faq.answer: Ordinary barnyard chickens in settled lands can answer the gesture. They are most often found around human farms, such as those in Westfall.

faq.q: How do you complete the quest once you have the feed?
faq.answer: Carry Special Chicken Feed and find a chicken. Cheer it on as it eats, and it lays an egg beneath itself for you to collect.

faq.q: What do you get for finishing the quest?
faq.answer: The fed chicken lays a Farm Chicken Egg at its feet. Collect it to receive a Chicken Egg that lets you summon a loyal Westfall chicken to follow you on your travels.

angles.text: At the Saldean Farmstead in Westfall, this odd chicken ritual has become a familiar tale among young Alliance adventurers exploring the battered rural kingdom.
The chicken's Special Chicken Feed can be eaten, though most cooks save the coarse grain for the birds.
